comparison: Incremental alphabet-union measurement: frozen 873d fitting-tail candidate versus 72c alphabet-union candidate; not a main comparison.
scope: Fixed 131072-row SQL ReplicatedApply including final group fold; three durable members, no RF3/network/admission. One operation per run; three alternating pairs per workload.

timed: Per-batch key/value generation, mutation construction, command assembly, apply, and completion/publication checks.
The final full-group checkpoint and fold.
untimed: Database/schema/bootstrap and benchmark fixture construction before b.ResetTimer.
Post-append and post-fold statistics and file-space sampling.
timer_boundary.detail: fillRows runs after b.ResetTimer; the final group.Checkpoint is bracketed by StartTimer/StopTimer.

ratio_definition: Ratios are baseline ns/op divided by candidate ns/op; values above 1 favor the candidate. Ratio-of-medians and median-paired-ratio are separate statistics.

command_template.order: Three alternating pairs per workload: control/candidate, candidate/control, control/candidate.
